text:
Nora: Quick ask-the-room — if we had to ban one phrase from Slack for a week (no workarounds!), what would it be? 😂
Ethan: "Circle back". Immediately.
Priya: "Ping me" — it's either urgent or not, stop using it as filler.
Sam: "Per my last email" — passive-aggressive energy.
Luc: "Low-hanging fruit" — corporate fruit discrimination.
phrase-bot: Vote with emoji: :one: circle back :two: ping me :three: per my last email :four: low-hanging fruit
Nora: Bonus: suggest a replacement phrase that makes people smile.
Ethan: Replace "circle back" with "let's boomerang this" (yes it's worse but more honest).
Priya: For "ping me" use "tap me gently".
Sam: For "per my last email" use a gif of a carrier pigeon delivering an angry note.
Luc: For "low-hanging fruit" use "ripe plum", sounds nicer.
Nora: Also rules: any use of banned phrase gets one virtual cookie deducted. 🍪
Priya: Who's in charge of cookie bookkeeping? @Sam? 😏
Sam: I accept. I will only deduct for repeat offenders.
Ethan: I'm voting :one: but will attempt to sneak in 'circle back' in pirate speak.
Nora: Poll locked at 15:00. Loser provides cookies (virtual or IRL) and composes a cheerful replacement phrase guide.
